newsitem.title: UK: Polar Air ups NY-Europe-Delhi weekly flights to three.
newsitem.headline: Polar Air ups NY-Europe-Delhi weekly flights to three.

text.p: Polar Air Cargo Inc said that it has increased the frequency of its New York-Europe-New Delhi round-trip service to three flights a week from its existing once weekly flight.

This started six months ago and; "We have been very pleased with the market's response to our scheduled operation," Polar Air executive vice-president, Jack Kane said in a statement issued from the company's Long Beach headquarters.

"Our ability to combine U.S.-India, U.S.-Europe and Europe-India freight on our (Boeing )747 aircraft strengthens the entire operation, allowing us to continue to build our presence both in India and Europe," he added.

Kane said that over the next 12 months the airline will continue to increase the levels of its scheduled services in key international markets, and that Polar Air will enter new markets when attractive opportunities occur. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
